description: Turn a Toast link, shortUrl, or GUID into the restaurant GUID that toast_get_menu needs. Links that carry a GUID (toast.app r-<guid> links, ?guid= parameters, bare GUIDs) resolve without a network call; an order.toasttab.com/online/<shortUrl> link or bare shortUrl is looked up in Toast by its slug. Returns guid: null with a next step when Toast does not know the slug.

reference.description: A Toast ordering link, toast.app link, restaurant GUID, or shortUrl slug.

name: toast_resolve_restaurant
